sources.details: A andB share colorred/shapesquare/pitchlow; identicalfamily cannot be disjoint training and heldout. Cblue/circle/high has distinctfamily. NLL is gold continuation score and does not equate to greedy accuracy. A checksum compares bytes only and cannot imply labels/test independence. These are direct set/ratio implications, not empirical quality generalizations.
